contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 10
acceptance_criteria: The sole visual authority remains .ai/references/TASK-0122-product-owner-mockup.png, SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df, 1536 x 1024 pixels and 1649791 bytes; the immutable Rework 7 numerical visual contract remains binding.

Only Rework 10 is active. Rework 10 is limited to the two remaining Rework 9 Architect-review blockers; all earlier sections are historical, while previously accepted Rework 7 through Rework 9 constraints remain preservation requirements.
The primary layout block reserves the maximum actual primary-panel height and must not remain 218px when Exposed Assets may resolve to 230px.
Exposed Assets resolves to 230px plus or minus 4px; the other four primary panels retain 218px plus or minus 4px; all second-row panels retain 213px plus or minus 4px.

The layout satisfies secondaryRowTop greater than or equal to primaryRowTop plus maxPrimaryPanelHeight plus requiredGap; the Rework 7 inter-row gap remains within plus or minus 3px and is measured after the tallest primary panel.
A focused vertical-geometry contract test evaluates the complete arithmetic and fails for the former 218px primary track plus 230px child plus 10px gap overlap configuration.

No primary or secondary panel overlaps, clips or creates horizontal or vertical overflow at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom; the lower 632:722 split and every other numerical tolerance remain satisfied.
The unavailable Risk Trend panel retains visible plot-area, chart-frame and X/Y-axis or baseline geometry consistent with the mockup.

When no authoritative series exists, Risk Trend renders no data-series path, measurement point, rising segment, falling segment, fluctuating contour, fake time series or implied positive or negative direction.

The trend regression inspects semantic and structural geometry rather than only role=img or arbitrary SVG path existence and fails if unavailable rendering introduces a directional or fluctuating data-series shape.

A truthful visible unavailable state remains in the chart shell and is never represented as successful trend output; no product number, observation, time value, direction or security fact is invented.
Finding, Threat Intelligence, Incident and Command Center retain separate real routes and focused routing regressions.

UTF-8 and mojibake protection, Gauge, Donut, status visualization, lower split, all remaining panel contracts, truthful states, Explainability and URL-authoritative navigation remain passing without regression.
No fake data, invented product value, backend change, provider execution, immutable-reference change, wider redesign or prohibited-file change is introduced.
Run focused EnterpriseSOCDashboard and DashboardPage tests, the full vertical no-overlap arithmetic test, truthful-trend semantics test, all four routing regressions and rendered UTF-8 regression.
Run the full frontend regression in regular parallel mode and with maxWorkers=1, TypeScript, production build, git diff --check, Scope Guard and immutable-reference hash verification.

Architect Implementation Review must directly confirm no overlap, Exposed Assets at 230px plus or minus 4px, the actual required gap, tested full arithmetic, visible neutral chart structure, no invented trend semantics and continued PASS of every accepted Rework 9 criterion.
Product Owner screenshot comparison at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom remains the final gate; do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
